text: Does the founder have prior exits (IPOs, acquisitions) under their belt?
Has the founder overseen acquisitions valued at over $150M?
Did the founder attend a QS top 50 university?
Is the founder's highest degree a PhD or higher?
Has the founder held a CEO role in a company with over 1,000 employees?
Has the founder been involved in venture capital or private equity?
Did the founder hold any leadership roles before starting their current startup?
Has the founder worked in companies with over 10,000 employees?
Did the founder serve as an advisor or board member for startups?
Does the founder have a background in engineering or technical fields?
Does the founder have experience in multiple industries (3+)?
Has the founder founded a startup in their industry before?
Has the founder been involved in clinical research or development?
Has the founder held a role as an Associate Professor or Scientist?
Is the founder's highest degree a BS or lower?
